# CG-RES-010: Response type narrowed

A response value has fewer possible JSON types.

**Why it matters:** Narrower responses are always handled.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.typeChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} now only returns {to} (was {from}).
>
> Consumers handle a subset of what they handled before.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: [string, integer] → string

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, integer]}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) now only returns string (was integer \| string).

### Does not fire: widening

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, integer]}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-RES-010
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:

```
